title: Marketing Simulator 2005 (a marketing mini game)
author: newpro_464
selftext:
Going for incremental/click-style game with retro office vibes. 

Wanted practice building games and decided to make a marketing mini-game for my business. Main concern is playtime... want long enough to have fun but still get to the end screen with the marketing message.  May still be too long. One person suggested should be 30 seconds max. 

Built this fully in Claude over a few days (javascript/html). More iterations than I probably should have spent on this but was having fun.

Welcome any feedback - try it here: [https://lp.teraleap.io/game2005/](https://lp.teraleap.io/game2005/)
